ja505:1.1: Ko taṃ hiṃsati heṭheti, kin nu dummano socasi [appatīto], kass' ajja mātāpitaro rudantu, kv-ajja setu nihato paṭhavyā
ja505:2.1: ti. Tuṭṭho 'smi deva tava dassanena, cirass' apassāmi taṃ bhūmipāla, ahiṃsako Renu-m-anuppavissa puttena te heṭhayito 'smi devā 'ti.
ja505:3.1: Āyantu dovārikā khaggabaddhā, kāsāviyā yantu antepuran taṃ, hantvāna taṃ Somanassaṃ kumāraṃ chetvānā sīsaṃ varaṃ āharantu.
ja505:4.1: Pesitā rājino dūtā kumāraṃ etad abravuṃ: issarena vitiṇṇo si, vadhappatto si khattiya.
ja505:5.1: Sa rājaputto paridevayanto dasaṅguliṃ añjalim paggahetvā: aham pi icchāmi janinda daṭṭhuṃ, jīvaṃ panetvā paṭidassayetha.
ja505:6.1: Tassa taṃ vacanaṃ sutvā rañño puttaṃ adassayuṃ, putto ca pitaraṃ disvā dūrato v' ajjhabhāsatha:
ja505:7.1: Āgañchu dovārikā khaggabhaddhā kāsāviyā hantu mamaṃ janinda, akkhāhi me pucchito etam atthaṃ: aparādho ko n' īdha mam' ajja atthīti.
ja505:8.1: Sāyañ ca pāto udakaṃ sajāti aggiṃ sadā paricaraṇappamatto, taṃ tādisaṃ saṃyataṃ brahmacāriṃ kasmā tuvaṃ brūsi gahapatīti gatham āha.
ja505:9.1: Tālā ca mūlā ca phalā ca deva pariggahā vividhā santi-m-assa, te rakkhati gopayat' appamatto, brāhmaṇo gahapati tena hotīti gātham āha.
ja505:10.1: Saccaṃ kho etaṃ vadasī kumāra, pariggahā vividhā santi-m-assa, te rakkhati gopayat' appamatto, brāhmaṇo gahapati tena hotīti gātham āha.
ja505:11.1: Suṇantu mayhaṃ parisā samāgatā sanegamā jānapadā ca sabbe: bāl' āyaṃ, bālassa vaco nisamma ahetunā ghātayate janindo ti.
ja505:12.1: Daḷhasmi mūle visate virūḷhe dunnikkhayo veḷu pasākhajāto, vandāmi pādāni tavaṃ janinda, anujāna maṃ, pabbajissāmi devā 'ti.
ja505:13.1: Bhuñjassu bhoge vipule kumāra, sabbañ ca te issariyam dadāmi, ajj' eva tvaṃ Kuranaṃ hohi rājā, mā pabbajī, pabbajjā hi dukkhā.
ja505:14.1: Kin nū 'dha deva tavam atthi bhogā, pubbe v' ahaṃ devaloke ramissaṃ rūpehi saddehi atho rasehi gandhehi passehi manoramehi.
ja505:15.1: Bhuttā me bhogā tidivasmi deva parivāritā accharāsaṃ gaṇena, tavañ ca bālaṃ paraneyyaṃ viditvā na tādise rājakule vaseyyaṃ.
ja505:16.1: Sacc' āhaṃ bālo paraneyy' āham asmi, ekāparādhaṃ khama putta mayhaṃ, puna pi ce edisakaṃ bhaveyya yathāmatiṃ somanassaṃ karohīti.
ja505:17.1: Anisamma kataṃ kammaṃ anavatthāya cintitaṃ -- bhesajjasseva vebhaṅgo vipāko hoti pāpako.
ja505:18.1: Nisamma ca kataṃ kammaṃ sammāvatthāya cintitaṃ -- bhesajjasseva sampatti vipāko hoti bhadrako.
ja505:19.1: Alaso gihī kāmabhogī na sādhu, (III154|23) asaññato pabbajito na sādhu, rājā na sādhu anisammakārī, yo paṇḍito kodhano taṃ na sādhu.
ja505:20.1: Nisamma khattiyo kayirā nānisamma disampati, nisammakārino rāja yaso kittī ca viḍḍhati.
ja505:21.1: Nisamma daṇḍaṃ paṇayeyya issaro, vegā kataṃ tapate bhūmipāla, sammāpaṇidhi ca narassa atthā anānutappā te bhavanti pacchā.
ja505:22.1: Anānutappāni hi ye karonti vibhajja kammāyatanāmi loke viññūpasatthāni sukhudrayāni bhavanti vaddhānumatāni tāni.
ja505:23.1: Āgañchu dovārikā khaggabaddhā kāsāviyā hantu mamaṃ janinda, mātuc-ca aṃkasmi ahaṃ nisino ākaḍḍhito sāhasā tehi deva.
ja505:24.1: Kaṭukaṃ hi sambādham sukiccha patto, madhuraṃ piyaṃ jīvitaṃ laddha rāja kicchen' ahaṃ ajja vadhā pamutto, pabbajjam evābhimano 'ham asmīti.
ja505:25.1: Putto vatāyaṃ taruṇo Sudhamme anukampako Somanasso kumāro taṃ yācamāno na labhāmi s' ajja, arahāsi naṃ yācitave tuvam pīti gāthaṃ āha.
ja505:26.1: Ramassu bhikkhācariyāya putta, nisamma dhammesu paribbajassu, sabbesu bhūtesu nidhāya daṇḍaṃ anindito Brahmam upeti ṭhānan ti gātham
ja505:27.1: āha. Acchariyarūpaṃ vata yādisañ ca, dukkhitaṃ maṃ dukkhāpayase Sudhamme, yācassu puttaṃ iti vuccamānā bhiyyo va ussāhayase kumāran ti.
ja505:28.1: Ye vippamuttā anavajjabhojino parinibbutā lokam imaṃ caranti tam ariyamaggaṃ paṭipajjamānaṃ na ussahe vārayituṃ kumāran ti.
ja505:29.1: Addhā have sevitabbā sapaññā (III306|22) bahussutā ye bahuṭhānacintino yes' āyaṃ sutvāna subhāsitāni appossukkā vītasokā Sudhammā ti.
